decisions.reason: The multi-model formwork profile line is core to the firm's integrated formwork offer and carries visible past investment, so management will attribute the missing web visibility in 2020–2021 to temporary causes and persist.
Automated distributor flow control embodies the announced automation strategy and in-house R&D, so management will defend it despite weak visibility.
The magnetic formwork strips are a multi-model line with a dedicated page and fit the core business, so the sunk investment and public commitment favour keeping them.
This component had its own web presence and complements the integrated formwork system, so dropping it would be hard to justify, though its absence from the website raises some doubt.
Commitment is lowest because the component was only mentioned online, overlaps with other magnetic parts and has not been seen since 2018, but it still costs little to keep within the system offer.
